items.stem: Which statement best describes the relationship between AI, machine learning and deep learning?

options.text: Deep learning is a subset of machine learning, which is a subset of AI
options.rationale: Correct: AI is the broadest field; ML is within it; deep learning is within ML.
The nesting is the other way around.
Deep learning is the narrowest of the three.

items.stem: When should you prefer a pre-built OCI AI service over training a custom model?

options.text: When the task is common and the pre-built service meets accuracy needs
options.rationale: Correct: pre-built services are faster/cheaper when they meet requirements.
Pre-built services do not fit every specialised need.

options.text: Only when you have no data at all
options.rationale: Data availability is not the sole deciding factor.

options.text: Never, custom models are always better
options.rationale: Custom models add cost/effort not always justified.

items.explanation: Correct: pre-built services are faster/cheaper when they meet requirements.

items.stem: Which TWO are important for responsible AI?

options.text: Checking training data for bias and quality
options.rationale: Correct: data quality and bias checks are core to responsible AI.
Correct: communicating limitations supports responsible use.
Ignoring fairness is not responsible AI.

options.text: Collecting as much personal data as possible
options.rationale: Excess data collection raises privacy risk.

items.explanation: Correct: data quality and bias checks are core to responsible AI.
